theorem.exactness: Repeated pure-variable and min(pos,neg)=1 Davis-Putnam elimination preserves SAT exactly via existential projection.
theorem.strict_progress: For p,q>0 with min(p,q)=1, clause count drops by at least one and variable count by one; Phi=n+m drops by at least two.
theorem.total_state: Clause count never increases during admitted steps and width is at most n0, so explicit CNF size is O(m0*n0); at most n0 eliminations.
theorem.reconstruction: Polynomial reverse reconstruction from stored elimination frames.
theorem.ceiling: TERMINAL BALANCED CORE NOT CLAIMED TRACTABLE.

authority.ceiling: POLYNOMIAL EXACT PREPROCESSING ONLY; NO TERMINAL-CORE SOLVER.

terminal_core.property: Every remaining variable has at least two positive and at least two negative occurrences.
terminal_core.source_hard_control: 3-SAT-(2,2), including the monotone variant, is NP-complete.
